notes: This candidate maps the tested control interaction to the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 management-object-model clause and the pinned official IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM resource. It checks federation-wide false/true/false effects through public callbacks and does not claim complete MOM or Auto Provide conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard federation HLAsetSwitches interaction permits a joined federate to send individual declared parameters, and HLAautoProvide sets the federation-wide Auto-Provide Switch to the provided value.
